task: AI-guided inverse design of recyclable vitrimeric polymers

components.name: Molecular Dynamics Simulations
components.role: Generate simulated Tg values for polymer structures
components.data_source: data/tg_calibration.csv (experimental + MD Tg), data/tg_vitrimer_MD.csv (vitrimer MD Tg)

components.name: Gaussian Process Calibration
components.role: Calibrate MD-simulated Tg to experimental Tg using Morgan fingerprints + MD Tg as features
components.method: GPR with RBF kernel + constant + white noise, PCA dimensionality reduction (30 components)

components.name: Graph Variational Autoencoder
components.role: Learn continuous latent representation of polymer SMILES for inverse design
components.method: Convolutional VAE with character-level SMILES encoding, latent dim=32
components.inverse_design: Latent space sampling + MLP surrogate for Tg prediction + nearest-neighbor retrieval
